name: FES Global Group
note: Official Sponsor of Aprilia Racing for the 2026 MotoGP season (its own news of 20 Jan 2026). Italian industrial surface-treatment company, FES S.p.A. of Lonato sul Garda (Brescia). Its own history page says the trade began with Luigi Farinon and that his son Massimo founded FES Sabbiature s.r.l. in 2013, which became FES Global Group S.p.A. in 2025, but no accessible source states the current shareholding, so no ownership claim yet.
